Measured instead by ink-projection on the 200 dpi raw render: AXIS IS 'x' and ROWS DESCEND IN x (the weber-rtl-rows shape) because the readable page's top edge is the render's RIGHT edge. Every row also carries an explicit hand-measured `geometry` string, which wins over this frame.
